result.human_summary: This educational material covers the BI-RADS® Mammography Lexicon with a focus on breast density classification. It includes detailed descriptions of four breast density categories, their impact on mammographic accuracy and cancer risk, and the structured approach to describing various mammographic findings. The material is visually rich with multiple figures illustrating different density categories, making it suitable for image-based learning.

recommendations.rationale: Multiple choice questions effectively test recognition and understanding of breast density categories, cancer risk relationships, and reporting requirements.
True/false statements are ideal for testing understanding of how breast density affects mammographic accuracy and technological mitigations.
Sequencing tasks help organize and understand the hierarchical classification of mass characteristics and calcification types.
Open-ended response allows students to explain the conceptual shift in breast density classification.

educational_units.title: Breast Density Categories
educational_units.description: Four categories of breast density (A-D) with their characteristics and clinical implications

educational_units.title: Breast Density Classification Changes
educational_units.description: Shift from percentage-based evaluation to likelihood-based assessment in BI-RADS

educational_units.title: Breast Density Variability
educational_units.description: Factors affecting breast density and the need for regular updates at each examination

educational_units.title: Impact on Mammographic Accuracy
educational_units.description: How breast density affects sensitivity and how technology mitigates this masking effect

educational_units.title: Breast Density and Cancer Risk
educational_units.description: Relationship between breast density and increased cancer risk with specific odds ratios

educational_units.title: BI-RADS® Lexicon Structure
educational_units.description: Hierarchical organization of terms in the mammography lexicon

educational_units.title: Mass Characteristics
educational_units.description: Shape, margin, and density characteristics of masses

educational_units.title: Calcification Types
educational_units.description: Classification of calcifications as typically benign or suspicious with morphological and distribution characteristics

educational_units.title: Other Findings
educational_units.description: Various findings including asymmetries, lymph nodes, skin lesions, etc.

educational_units.title: Reporting Requirements
educational_units.description: FDA legislation and guidance for breast density reporting

not_recommended.reason: Not suitable as the material contains factual information without intentional errors for correction.

result.illustrations_note: The material includes 16 figures (Figures 1-16) showing examples of each breast density category (A-D) in different views (SM, DM). These visual examples are essential for understanding the appearance of different density categories and should be incorporated into image-based tasks.
warnings: The material contains some formatting inconsistencies and potential typos (e.g., 'f ibroglandular' instead of 'fibroglandular', 'Figure?' instead of 'Figure 7'). These should be reviewed for accuracy before use in educational materials.
